questions.prompt_text: What is meant by an initial commit in a Git workflow?

options.text: A request to your team to review and approve changes
Officially recording the current state of your project’s files in the local Git repository
Retrieving changes made by the team and updating your local repository
Creating a local copy of the project’s code from the remote repository

questions.raw_block_text:
1.
Question 1

What is meant by an initial commit in a Git workflow?

Do you understand?.

I understand

A request to your team to review and approve changes 

Officially recording the current state of your project’s files in the local Git repository 

Retrieving changes made by the team and updating your local repository 

Creating a local copy of the project’s code from the remote repository 

Nice work

Correct! An initial commit is the process of officially recording and saving the current state of your project’s files in the local Git repository. This step marks the starting point of your project’s version history.

1 / 1 point
